pages.title: Firing Results Overview
pages.text: Different greenware items produce different products under different conditions. Failed conditions produce kiln waste shard.$(br2)Firing judgment uses peak temperature (highest temperature during firing) and final oxygen content.$(br2)Below are the firing conditions and products for all greenware types.

§bGray Crucible§r$(br2)Conditions:$(br)$(li)Oxygen < -30 (reducing atmosphere)$(br)$(li)Peak temperature > 900℃$(br2)Failure: Produces 2 kiln waste shard. §dUndried§0 greenware has a §c15%§0 chance to fail even when conditions are met.$(br2)Gray crucible is heat-resistant and the basic tool for metal smelting.

§4Red Mold§r$(br2)Conditions:$(br)$(li)Oxygen > 30 (oxidizing atmosphere)$(br)$(li)Peak temperature > 850℃$(br2)Failure: Produces 1 kiln waste shard. §dUndried§0 greenware has a §c15%§0 chance to fail even when conditions are met.$(br2)Red mold is used for casting metal ingots and tools.

§7Fire Brick§r$(br2)Conditions:$(br)$(li)Peak temperature > 1000℃$(br)$(li)Time above 900℃ > 300 ticks (15 seconds)$(br2)Failure: Produces 4 kiln waste shard. §dUndried§0 greenware has a §c15%§0 chance to fail even when conditions are met.$(br)Success: Produces §d2§0 fire bricks$(br2)Fire brick is a building material that requires sustained high heat.

§8Ceramic Blowpipe§r$(br2)Conditions:$(br)$(li)Oxygen < -50 (strong reducing atmosphere)$(br)$(li)Peak temperature > 950℃$(br2)Failure: Produces 1 kiln waste shard. §dUndried§0 greenware has a §c15%§0 chance to fail even when conditions are met.$(br2)Ceramic blowpipe is used to boost heating rate and max kiln temperature by blowing air.

pages.title: Firing Strategy Tips
pages.text: $(li)§bGray Crucible§r: Seal fire mouth + fully close vents, maintain reducing atmosphere until oxygen<-30, ensure temp>900℃.$(br)$(li)§4Red Mold§r: Open fire mouth + fully open vents, maintain oxidizing atmosphere until oxygen>30, temp>850℃.$(br)$(li)§7Fire Brick§r: Requires highest temperature and sustained high heat, suggest 4-sided insulation + grate + fully closed vents.
